name: BBDM
configuration:
seed: 42
study: her2match_bbdm
output_dir: <local path>
data:
  task: breast_he_to_ihc
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: train.csv
  val_manifest: val.csv
  test_manifest: test.csv
  marker: HER2
  datasets:
  - HER2Match
  crop_size: 256
  geometry: physical_resolution
  target_mpp: 0.46
  identity_protocol: her2match_author_cases_v1
  workers: 4
  persistent_workers: false
  timeout: 0
  sampling: uniform
model:
  name: bbdm
  in_channels: 3
  image_size: 256
  inner_channel: 128
  channel_mults:
  - 1
  - 1
  - 2
  - 2
  - 4
  - 4
  res_blocks: 2
  attn_res:
  - 8
  - 16
  - 32
  num_head_channels: 64
  dropout: 0.0
  use_checkpoint: true
  timesteps: 1000
  sampling_steps: 200
  sampling_seed: 1042
  max_var: 1.0
  eta: 1.0
  loss_type: l1
ema:
  enabled: true
  decay: 0.999
loss:
  l1: 1.0
  perceptual: 0.0
validation:
  lpips: true
  selection_metric: lpips
  selection_mode: min
  save_best_psnr: true
  weights: ema
  fp32: true
  unpadded: true
  aggregation: tile_mean
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 15
    min_delta: 0.0
    warmup_steps: 3625
    warmup_epochs: 5
    warmup_checks: 5
train:
  max_steps: 100000
  batch_size: 4
  lr: 0.0001
  schedule: constant
  warmup_steps: 0
  l1_priming_steps: 0
  amp: bf16
  grad_clip: 1.0
  validate_every: 2000
  checkpoint_every: 500
  log_every: 50
  validate_initial: false
  max_seconds: 900
  reference_steps_per_epoch: 725
breast_protocol:
  direction: he_to_ihc
  marker_conditioning: single_marker
  resolution: 0.46um/px; 256px crops
  status: production
  identity: her2match_author_cases_v1
  selection: minimum validation LPIPS
  implementation: pixel-space BBDM adaptation; not exact HER2match paper reproduction
  upstream_commit: 02c3b13c9f9dfab0853e32123100680a0640c4ed
  inference: source endpoint only; fixed common Gaussian trajectory; 200 reverse steps;
    no target-based draw selection
  dataset: HER2Match
  manifest_sha256:
    train: 6c8cb9f704e5df8062b15c78b1d6226569e46dd7e24fcb919dbbcf6869fe7cb2
    val: f9bf0dc0a3417cb436238df636b973dfd4cb5fbef96e5eb162c48b65a3f983f8
    test: b7c4c58ae39d40aa3366b7e543fba0f0a35572f816b2d88d72177bf864e1dc99
  source: https://zenodo.org/records/15797050
  external_validation: false
